Linux x64 FFmpeg build record. Built 2026-11-10.

Compiler: gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0
Assembler: NASM version 2.16.01
Host: Ubuntu 24.04.5, linux x86-64

rebuild.sh produced this binary from the tarballs in sources/. No patches were applied.
The script's default work directory is /tmp/futureox-ffmpeg-rebuild, and the shipped
ffmpeg -version configuration line records that prefix.

Sources:
- FFmpeg n7.0.2, sources/ffmpeg-n7.0.2.tar.gz
  https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/refs/tags/n7.0.2.tar.gz
- libvpx 1.15.2, sources/libvpx-1.15.2.tar.gz
  https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx/archive/refs/tags/v1.15.2.tar.gz
- x264 commit b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55
  sources/x264-b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55.tar.gz
  https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264/-/archive/b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55/x264-b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55.tar.gz

libx264 and libvpx are linked into the executable. glibc and libz.so.1 stay dynamic
system libraries and are not part of this source tree.

The executable is GPL-3.0-or-later because rebuild.sh passes --enable-gpl and
--enable-version3. x264 is GPL-2.0-or-later. libvpx 1.15.2 is BSD. FFmpeg n7.0.2
without those switches is LGPL-2.1-or-later. License texts are COPYING.GPLv2,
COPYING.GPLv3, COPYING.LGPLv2.1, COPYING.LGPLv3, x264-COPYING, and libvpx-LICENSE.

The Rust sidecar spawns this program. It is not linked into Electron or the design
kernel, and that spawn does not decide the license of the rest of Futureox Design.

This binary replaces the earlier johnvansickle 7.0.2-static executable. That build's
release-source index did not contain a matching source archive.
